featured_reviews.name: Divya Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text: I absolutely adore Masilo's baby products! From their super soft swaddles to their adorable bedding sets, everything is made with the utmost care and quality. My little one sleeps so comfortably in their organic muslin crib sheets. I highly recommend Masilo to all new parents!

featured_reviews.name: Komal Chandak
featured_reviews.review_text: Masilo has been a game-changer for my baby's nursery. I stumbled upon their products when I was looking for organic and eco-friendly options for my little one. Their swaddles are an absolute must-have! Not only are they incredibly soft, but they are also breathable, making them perfect for all seasons. The added bonus is the beautiful hand-painted prints. I love how Masilo seamlessly combines functionality with style.

featured_reviews.name: Krisha Chakraborty
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had started looking for baby products for my nephew & stumbled upon Masilo. Organic, cotton, non-toxic were few things in my mind. I couldn't directly order for them as I waited for the baby's arrival to select the colour & needed before they came home from hospital. Amazon made it easy in 2days delivery.
Coming to the product, they are slightly on the higher side of pricing from most other available brands. However, the touch & feel will tell the difference. Had ordered the Star bedding set & 3 Swaddle wraps. Came to close to 14K. We totally love them. It's good investment & I am sure Masilo will be my first stop for future purchases.

featured_reviews.name: Esha Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: Very modern yet cute prints/designs, but most importantly good quality organic cotton (what all new moms are looking for). Got my baby’s swaddles from here which were amazing. Highly recommend it. Awaiting more baby items to be added to their collection!

featured_reviews.name: Sowmya Ravi
featured_reviews.review_text: Love all their products. The swaddles (and most of the textiles) are super soft and remain soft wash after wash. Nestilo is so perfect for an infant - very comfortable & safe to use. The products have a lot of insight and thought, very practical to buy & use for a new mom.

featured_reviews.name: neha bafna
featured_reviews.review_text: I was gifted a masilo blanket for my baby and I absolutely loved the material and quality of the product. All their products are so well thought and come in such pleasing colours and cute prints. Totally recommend them if you’re looking for the best for your baby! ☺️

featured_reviews.name: Alneema Ashraf
featured_reviews.review_text: I love godilo the most in Masilo products. For  my baby, godilo is perfect and she loved it too. My baby is super comfort in that because it’s super soft and it’s doesn’t contain any rings or buckles and also it’s 100% cotton. The three different prints are also very beautiful. I can carry until she s 12kgs. Actually I’m searching a product like this.Thanking for introducing such an amazing product to the market
